purpose: Provide a rigorous, source-grounded framework for multi-lens case analysis.
critique_protocol: Quote or pinpoint the authority before characterizing the reasoning.
Identify the interpretive methodology actually used.
Test the strongest opposing interpretation before calling the reasoning defective.
Do not label an argument a logical fallacy merely because it reaches an unfavorable policy result.
Search later cases before asserting a doctrinal trend.
Search empirical sources before making institutional or behavioral claims.
Separate legally relevant asymmetry from unsupported claims of bias.
State what the opinion leaves unresolved.
